exposure: Timing of primary cesarean delivery (planned, intrapartum first stage, intrapartum second stage)
outcome: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: Women with a primary cesarean and subsequent term cephalic vaginal delivery
finding: Cesarean delivery during the second stage of labor is associated with a longer second stage of labor and an increased operative delivery rate at the subsequent vaginal birth compared to planned cesarean or cesarean during the first stage of labor.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery in the second stage of labor is associated with a longer second stage and increased operative delivery rate at subsequent vaginal birth.
